scripts.watch: concurrently "nodemon --watch resume.md --watch assets/css/resume.css --ext md,css --exec 'sh scripts/build-resume.sh'" "browser-sync start --server --files resume.html --startPath resume.html --port 3000"
scripts.site:
printf -- '---
layout: resume
permalink: /resume/
title: Benjamin Smith
---

' | cat - resume.md > _pages/resume.md && bundle exec jekyll serve
